name: Médica Sur, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Médica Sur, S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a healthcare hospital in Mexico. The company offers hospital services such as Surgical units; central operating rooms, gynecology and obstetrics operating rooms, and short-stay surgery; intensive care unit, intermediate care unit, and the coronary care unit; emergency department includes adult and pediatric care; hospital wards; blood bank; and pathological anatomy. It also provides clinical and diagnostic services such as comprehensive cancer center, radiotherapy unit, scalpel-free radiosurgery unit gamma knife, gastroenterology, hepatology and endoscopy, advanced urology, center for neurology and neurosurgery, neurophysiology, rehabilitation medicine,…
